actualInventory.goal: Opit vertaamaan ja järjestämään negatiivisia ja positiivisia kokonaislukuja lukusuoran avulla: oikealla on aina suurempi.
actualInventory.intro: Talvinen lampi. Negatiiviset luvut järjestetään lukusuoralla: oikealla aina suurempi.

whyAt.2: Tämä on 2, nollasta oikealle. Miinusmerkkinen luku on vasemmalla.
whyAt.-1: Yksi askel liian lähellä nollaa. Laske askeleet nollasta.
whyAt.-3: Yksi askel liian kauas. Laske askeleet nollasta.

split.say: Lajittele luvut: ovatko ne pienempiä vai suurempia kuin −4?
split.hint: Kuvittele lukusuora. Kaikki −4:n vasemmalla puolella olevat ovat pienempiä.

why: Tässä on järjestetty etäisyyden nollasta mukaan, ei lukusuoran mukaan.
Negatiiviset ovat väärin päin: −7 on pienempi kuin −5.

order.hint: Aloita vasemmanpuoleisimmasta: kumpi negatiivisista on kauempana nollasta?

why: −6 on kauempana nollasta vasemmalla, joten se on pienempi.

compare.hint: Kumpi on lukusuoralla oikeammalla? Ajattele lämpömittaria: kumpi on lämpimämpi?

why: Kärki osoittaisi lukuun −9, mutta pienempi on −11: se on vasemmalla.

transfer.hint: Lämpimin on suurin luku: se, joka on lähimpänä nollaa.

actualInventory.registry: Direct actual NodeSpec; global index/families/motionsims inspected, no target SIMS/family override, own goal/rev retained.

familyTreatment.compare: Larger of two negatives, left/right position.
familyTreatment.order: Mixed signed list; wrong absolute-value ordering vs correct numerical ordering.
familyTreatment.place: Place negative integer on a line with sign/off-by-one whys.
familyTreatment.split: Classify five unique points as less/greater than negative pivot.
familyTreatment.transfer: Read supplied fictional town temperatures and choose greatest/warmer; nearest-zero hint is only valid because source uses all negatives.

alignment.introDemoTreatment: Animated lineSort[-3,5,−8,0], then thermometer−3/−7. Own pivot exploration and generically checked constructed pairs replace a fixed answer choice.
alignment.animationInventory: Read neganim thermoScene1–39, iceHops44–86, lineSortScene92–128, unit interpolation/caption and manual replacement limits. Original SVG subjects only; supplied PNG mascots are not redrawn.
alignment.registry: Actual index preserves own goal/AUDIT_REV; family defaults, no target-specific family/SIMS override for these3. GOALS fallback exists globally but own goals already supplied.

audit.scope: Read actual critique/correction, not just index. Historical source tests/native are not this package evidence.

alignment.coverageReconciliation: Old COVERAGE omits split and understates actual2 demos as1.
alignment.comparison: Retain position, signed comparison, pivot split and contextual threshold. Learner constructs any supported pair satisfying a general predicate, with multiple valid answers and explicit strict/inclusive boundaries. Distance is contrasted, not substituted for order.
alignment.assumptionsAndLimits: Canonical prerequisite AND groups preserved. NEG03 is only strong support for both M79 nodes; not a new gate. Own narrow format/domains declared; no copied automatic mastery/confidence reward.
reconciliations: Immutable Lite not modified. IM source sorted-temperature worked list error recorded in research, own examples calculated independently. All-negative nearest-zero shortcut is not generalized to positives.

planning.childGoal: Löydän useita lukuja, jotka täyttävät lukusuoran järjestysehdon.
planning.assumed: Number-line placement fromNEG02; NEG03 also assumes whole-number comparisonNUM10. Height/metre/°C reference supplied and taught; no geometry/object naming/speech gate.
planning.scope: Integer model/pair domain−10..10; strict less/greater, negative/positive vszero, open interval and equality boundary. General predicates accept all valid pairs, not answer whitelist.
planning.support: Early free model, direct answer supported; optional help, teacher/offline and exit. No mandatory model progression or audio.
planning.executionLimits: Finite manual one-unit changes, not measured time or physical instrument readings. Ordinary integer-valued signed decimal strings with harmless leading/trailing zeros, raw128limit; no expression, fraction, exponent or rounding acceptance.
planning.evidenceLimits: Local supported current-response check only, no persistence/history/mastery award, formal independent/retained competence, learner or efficacy approval. Canonical atomic role retained, not evidence creation.
